instrument_name: 2026 Withholding Tables for Individual Income Tax (revised Dec 2025) with instructions
article_or_section: Instructions 3-6; Percentage Method 2026; Common Items of Income
figure_or_rule_carried: Percentage method: annualize wages; subtract allowances at 2026 personal exemption 5,300 and the standard deduction as adjusted in the booklet (basic standard deduction single 15,300 / married 30,600, phased out above 102,250 single / 204,550 joint); single schedule 5.80% below 27,400, 1,589 + 6.75% to 64,850, 4,117 + 7.15% above; annual result divided by pay periods and rounded to the nearest dollar. Status from Form W-4ME box 3 (married table vs single table; head of household uses single). Federal W-4 Step 4(b) deductions NOT used. Supplemental: with regular wages = aggregate as one payment; paid separately = flat 5%. Nonwage flat 5%. Maine W-4ME required (allowances no longer based on federal W-4). Married schedule in the booklet not transcribed.
